authoring: Physics and world components with retained runtime bindings

actions.action: Select World Navigation; bake, cancel, rebake and change clearance/cost/algorithm.
actions.expected: Only complete current bakes publish; cancellation is visible and can be retried.

actions.action: Play and use WASD; Navigator pursues Player around Navigation Barrier. Move the barrier while paused.
actions.expected: Dynamic geometry invalidates the route; the next bake/repath respects the new obstacle.

actions.action: Inspect World Studio → Streaming and the status card.
actions.expected: Streamed Landmarks installs its actual visible/queryable landmark while the cell is active. Failed dependencies stay stopped until repaired and retried.

actions.action: Pause, select Player and shift the origin in the status card.
actions.expected: Relative positions and UUIDs are retained; the displayed absolute offset increases. Stop restores the authored scene.

actions.action: Save/reopen and export the exact project.
actions.expected: The exported components, navigation source, scene dependency and package permissions match the editor.

actions.action: Read the visible X/Y meter values while playing in editor and export.
actions.expected: The readout follows the subject through the ordinary Rhai transform/UI APIs at10Hz; it can be compared with the Inspector while paused.
